format: Folup funnel specification; configure manually, not a PostHog API payload
count_unit: unique anonymous browser ID, not people or email clicks

funnels.name: Activation: access to first saved voice note
Guest first: try to saved account note

notes: Use each browser's first completed activation in the selected cohort; do not count every note as a new activation.
The guest path intentionally processes before signing in. Do not judge it using the signed-in recording funnel.
Calendar is optional and must not be required for activation.
Deduplicate result-volume SQL by event UUID; PostHog ingestion can show retries before eventual deduplication.
Keep unknown internal status out of reports rather than treating it as external traffic.
Historical sessions, campaign attribution and internal flags cannot be reconstructed from missing data.
